Types include directed exchange (secure messaging to known recipients), query-based exchange (patient record pull on demand), and consumer-mediated exchange (patient-controlled data sharing). AI benefits from HIE by accessing longitudinal multi-site records.

front: What is the CMS Interoperability and Patient Access final rule (2020)?
back: The CMS Interoperability and Patient Access rule requires CMS-regulated payers (Medicare Advantage, Medicaid) to implement FHIR R4 APIs enabling patient access to their claims, clinical, and formulary data via third-party apps, accelerating payer-provider data exchange for AI population health tools.

front: What is HIPAA's definition of Protected Health Information (PHI)?
back: PHI is individually identifiable health information created, received, maintained, or transmitted by a covered entity or business associate that relates to past, present, or future physical or mental health conditions, provision of care, or payment for care.

front: What is the IRB (Institutional Review Board) role in clinical AI research?
back: An IRB reviews clinical AI research involving human subjects to ensure ethical protections (informed consent, risk minimization, equitable subject selection). Studies using de-identified EHR data for model development may qualify for IRB exemption, while studies involving prospective data collection require full review.

front: What is the difference between clinical decision support rule-based alerts and ML-based alerts in an EHR?
back: Rule-based alerts fire on hard-coded logic (e.g., eGFR < 30 + nephrotoxic drug). ML-based alerts use trained models to generate probabilistic scores that trigger alerts at defined thresholds. ML alerts are harder to interpret but can integrate more variables and detect complex patterns.

front: What is the role of ICD-10 in AI model development for clinical informatics research?
back: ICD-10 codes are used to define patient cohorts, outcomes, and comorbidities in AI model development from claims or structured EHR data. Validated ICD-10 phenotype algorithms (from PheKB or eMERGE network) ensure that AI training labels accurately reflect clinical diagnoses.

front: What is a Clinical Data Repository (CDR) and how does it differ from a data warehouse?
back: A CDR stores real-time operational clinical data from multiple source systems for immediate clinical use (e.g., active patient records). A data warehouse stores historical, transformed data optimized for analytical queries and AI model training, with less emphasis on real-time currency.

front: What is the Arden Syntax and its use in clinical decision support?
back: Arden Syntax is an HL7 standard language for writing clinical decision support rules as Medical Logic Modules (MLMs). It is one of the oldest CDS knowledge representation formats, though it has largely been superseded by CQL (Clinical Quality Language) and CDS Hooks for modern EHR integration.

front: What is AMIA (American Medical Informatics Association) and its role in clinical informatics education?
back: AMIA is the professional organization for biomedical and health informatics in the US. It publishes the Journal of the American Medical Informatics Association (JAMIA), offers the AMIA 10x10 clinical informatics training program, and advocates for informatics as a recognized medical specialty.

front: What is clinical quality language (CQL) and how does it enable AI-driven quality measurement?
back: CQL (Clinical Quality Language) is an HL7 standard for expressing clinical quality measures and decision support logic in a human-readable, machine-executable format. It enables AI-driven quality measures to be specified, shared, and executed consistently across different EHR platforms.

front: What is the PCORI (Patient-Centered Outcomes Research Institute) and its relevance to clinical AI evaluation?
back: PCORI funds comparative effectiveness research emphasizing patient-centered outcomes. It supports clinical AI evaluation studies that measure real-world patient outcomes (quality of life, patient experience, functional status) rather than surrogate technical metrics like AUC alone.

front: What is the QCDR (Qualified Clinical Data Registry) and how does it use AI?
back: A QCDR is a CMS-approved registry that collects and submits quality measure data on behalf of clinicians for MIPS reporting. AI NLP and analytics tools automate data extraction from EHRs for QCDR reporting, reducing manual abstraction burden and improving measure accuracy.

front: What is a clinical natural language processing (NLP) evaluation framework?
back: NLP evaluation uses precision, recall, F1 score, and inter-annotator agreement (Cohen's kappa) against a gold-standard annotated corpus. For clinical NLP, evaluation must be stratified by note type, clinical setting, and patient demographics to assess real-world performance.

front: What is population health analytics and how does it differ from clinical analytics?
back: Population health analytics examines health outcomes and determinants across defined patient panels or geographic populations. Clinical analytics focuses on individual patient care metrics. AI enables population health analytics by processing millions of records to identify trends, disparities, and intervention opportunities at scale.

front: What is the eMERGE Network and its contribution to AI clinical informatics?
back: eMERGE (Electronic Medical Records and Genomics) is an NIH-funded consortium linking genomic biobanks with EHR data across multiple institutions. It developed validated EHR phenotyping algorithms and genomic-phenotypic association tools, serving as a model for AI-enabled precision medicine at scale.

front: What is the Clinical Informatics board exam format and key content areas?
back: The clinical informatics board exam (ABPM/ABPath) consists of approximately 200 multiple-choice questions covering health information systems, CDSS, analytics and data science, leadership and management, and health information exchange. Key content areas include EHR standards (FHIR, HL7), AI/ML applications, regulatory landscape, and governance.
